2	// Floor grid from `mcd plan`, origin [15, 1, 18] (x 15..18, z 18..24). Layout:
3	//  - focal piece: two candle racks on the east side (x=17): dark-oak fence uprights with a closed trapdoor shelf, and
4	//    a lit white_candle cluster on each shelf; the lanterns hang over them, so this is the brightest corner.
5	//  - tallow barrels at the back-west (x=15, z=18..19) with lit candles on top.
6	//  - the lane x=16 stays clear from the back door (16,2..3,18) to the south opening; x=18 stays clear to the east.
7	// Light: 2 hanging lanterns from the lean-to slab roof (y=4), 4 lit candle clusters.
8	import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";
9	
10	const LEGEND = {
11	  b: "barrel",
12	  F: "dark_oak_fence",
13	  T: ["dark_oak_trapdoor", { facing: "north", half: "top", open: "false", powered: "false", waterlogged: "false" }],
14	  C: ["white_candle", { candles: "3", lit: "true", waterlogged: "false" }],
15	  c: ["white_candle", { candles: "2", lit: "true", waterlogged: "false" }],
16	  L: ["lantern", { hanging: "true", waterlogged: "false" }],
17	};
18	
19	// y=1 (floor row), y=2 (candles), y=3 (lanterns); rows run along +z from z=18, columns along +x from x=15
20	const ROWS = [
21	  [ // y=1
22	    "b...", // z18
23	    "b.F.", // z19
24	    "..T.", // z20
25	    "..F.", // z21
26	    "..F.", // z22
27	    "..T.", // z23
28	    "..F.", // z24
29	  ],
30	  [ // y=2
31	    "c...", // z18
32	    "C...", // z19
33	    "..C.", // z20
34	    "....", // z21
35	    "....", // z22
36	    "..C.", // z23
37	    "....", // z24
38	  ],
39	  [ // y=3
40	    "....", // z18
41	    "....", // z19
42	    "..L.", // z20
43	    "....", // z21
44	    "....", // z22
45	    "..L.", // z23
46	    "....", // z24
47	  ],
48	];
49	
50	export function build(g) {
51	  layers(g, [15, 1, 18], LEGEND, ROWS);
52	}

The refusal messages compare block ids only. Room-4's cells now match grounds' ids, but I did not check grounds' block states (rack fence connections, trapdoor facing, candle counts) against what room-4 used to want, so the two parts' states may still differ slightly.

waste.what: Worked out which cells the earlier grounds part already held by reading parts/grounds.mjs-era refusals one cell at a time, then removing the y=1 layer and the two x=17 candle cells by hand and re-running make.sh twice to see what was left.
waste.cost: 3 make.sh runs, about 25 refused-cell comparisons, two layer rewrites of room-4.mjs
waste.tool: A cell-ownership report from runParts: for each refused cell, the owning part, that part's block and state, and whether it matches (for example, 'owned by Grounds and lean-to: same id, same state'). Or `mcd plan --owners build.nbt` to list each part's cells before a room part is written, so overlaps are found in one pass.

waste.what: Checked by hand that palette.json covers every block in room-4 (barrel, fences, trapdoor, white_candle, lantern). No off-palette block was reported, but I confirmed it from the parts-report.json grep rather than from one line of the make.sh output.
waste.tool: make.sh's per-part line could print 'offPalette: none' next to 'refused: 0' so the all-clear is visible without opening parts-report.json.

companions.task: Hand over the candle and lantern placement: the lit clusters on the barrels at x=15 and the hanging lanterns at y=3, so the lean-to's light falls on the racks and the lane stays clear.
